a script call has no time limit in modul: kept on purpose (2026-11-06): a call gets a second of its own time, the table work it asks for not counted; the tabletop freezes for good on a runaway loop, here the loop stops and its script and line are named
smooth moves end at once: compat.glide: a smooth move follows the tabletop's pull and damping in 50 Hz steps; scripts see it moving and the piece lands at the end
save quirk: a number written as a string: a number written as text reads as the game reads it; an object at NaN, or at the centre with no size, is left out as the game leaves it; a state saved with a NaN scale keeps the piece's own size, where the game destroys the piece on switching to it (decided by the user 2026-11-07)
save quirk: negative scale mirrors: a piece is mirrored on each axis its scale is negative, as Unity draws a negative localScale: picture, back, outline, mesh, decals, lines and glued parts (decided 2026-11-07); a piece drawn from a shared pack (stock dice, Firme's boxes and trees, baked bundle figures) is placed from a mirrored copy in the module's own pack, a die's faces turned with it
save quirk: rotX/rotZ near 180 means fac: a piece keeps its saved turn: heading and face down as before, the rest as its own tilt (a model its whole turn, 3D text from lying flat), resting on its lowest corner and picked where it stands; locked pieces keep it in the game and unlocked ones were saved at rest (decided 2026-11-07); a die keeps its rolled face and how far it leans off it, rolls from that lean and lands level
save quirk: duplicate GUIDs inside bags: a guid names the first piece found, as getObjectFromGUID answers in modules
